review.rationale: The original code raises a GlhsInvariantError when proposal.context_binding_mode is not equal to 'base_version_only', enforcing a runtime invariant check. The mutated code replaces the condition with 'if False:', which unconditionally prevents the error from ever being raised, regardless of the value of proposal.context_binding_mode. This means that proposals with any context_binding_mode value other than 'base_version_only' will no longer trigger the GlhsInvariantError. The observable behavioral difference is that the validation/guard is completely disabled: callers passing proposals with non-conforming binding modes will proceed past this check without an exception, whereas the original code would have raised GlhsInvariantError. This constitutes a clear, observable behavioral difference in control flow and exception propagation.
